task: T12a authenticated launch handoff and quarantine substrate
scope: T12a only; no T12b, T12c, native-profile qualification, or product-completion claim
repair_summary: Shadow comparison now requires both attempts to retain the same non-null observed runtime identity before any matched, suspected-miss, or unclassified-divergence verdict. Missing or differing identities are incomplete.

A valid pre-T12a base store is now read without mutation, nulls runtime identity, and exposes no quarantine; only a locked writer performs the all-or-nothing additive upgrade. Partial compound schemas and malformed base schemas fail closed.

Shadow verdicts are derived from actual test identities and selected-file attribution: matching outcomes including matching failures are matched, full-only attributable failures are suspected misses, overlap or unattributed disagreement is unclassified, and incomplete evidence is incomplete.

Incomplete, timed-out, cancelled, and source-invalidated shadow results persist every observed attempt, the failure union, and the whole-gate obligation; eligibility gates only quarantine set or clear.

Attempt evidence, comparison receipts, and quarantine rows count toward logical quotas. Pruning removes compound children atomically with their run, and orphaned evidence or receipts disable malformed history.
Runtime identities are strict 64-character lowercase hex digests; protocol fields require actual JSON integers, and qualified CompoundSupport capabilities require a profile.
A stopped first gate is source-invalid, keeps a001 NOT_RUN with null codes/timing, and emits no synthetic runner facts. Missing required native identity at a001 is zero-launch unknown-input.

Real-process evidence now covers setup/a001 ordering, 23 followed by 0 or 1, fresh one-use tokens, early/wrong-generation/wrong-direction/stop decisions, waiting SIGINT/SIGTERM, parent-only SIGKILL at a pending gate, adverse unknown/deep pending-gate frames with a live neighbor sentinel, a live descendant after direct-child exit, and bounded-observation exhaustion.
security_negative_contracts: Missing selected identity, missing full identity, or differing valid runtime identities cannot be classified as a selector divergence and cannot set or clear selection quarantine; publication still retains the incomplete receipt, both observed attempts, and failure obligations.

Malformed, wrong-protocol, wrong-run, wrong-nonce, wrong-generation, wrong-token, early, duplicate, replayed, wrong-direction, truncated, oversized, and out-of-order private traffic cannot authorize a child.
EOF, parent closing, cancellation, decision timeout, source invalidation, unknown required identity, live descendants, and exhausted predecessor observation close all later spawn.
Stopped or unstarted attempts remain NOT_RUN with null raw/final codes and null timing; an expired unopened gate has no synthetic runner-facts frame.
Incomplete shadows retain observed failures and whole-gate obligations without setting or clearing quarantine.
Quarantine clear is an in-transaction expected-row compare-and-delete after a newer eligible matched shadow and an intervening clean baseline matching a real policy or compatibility correction.
Older sequence, stale expected row, unchanged policy and compatibility, timeout, ordinary pass, another checkout, and existing health markers cannot clear quarantine.
History corruption, capacity, and publication marker bytes are preserved; no quarantine operation performs wider marker cleanup.
No legacy configuration, migration import, alias, cloud, remote backend, provider API, model, downgrade retry, or compatibility fallback was added.
